title: APT Commerce Compass
description: A working payments proof. Merchant signup, partner and merchant portals, and staff review are implemented. The money path is the APT sandbox processor.
excerpt: APT Commerce Compass is a working proof of a gateway and acquiring flow.   What a visitor can verify  The public site covers merchant signup, a partner portal, a merchant portal, and staff application review. Staff can approve or reject an application, and that decision is audited. The money path records a result through the APT sandbox processor.   What must not be claimed

title: APT Health Compass
description: A working personal health-review app. Periodic results and monthly supplements stay with the signed-in account. It is not medical advice and it does not publish health records.
excerpt: APT Health Compass is a working app for reading periodic health results next to the supplements taken that month.   What a visitor can verify  A signedin person can review their own imported results and the supplement record for that period. The public site is the app, not a shared dataset.   What must not be claimed

title: APT Site
description: The public portfolio. Cloudflare Pages serves the Vite and React app. A separate Worker reads those public files and returns the Labs, Proof, and Insights feeds.
excerpt: This site is the public Applied Practical Thinking portfolio.   What is implemented  The browser app is built with Vite and React and deployed on Cloudflare Pages. Authored pages live in `apps/web/content`. A Cloudflare Worker, deployed separately, reads the published indexes and markdown and serves the public feeds.   What must not be claimed

title: CRT World
description: The live author site for C. R. Thompson. Visitors discover the worlds on the public site. An admin surface and a Worker API with D1 manage what gets published.
excerpt: CRT World is the live author platform for C. R. Thompson.   What a visitor can verify  https://crthompson.net/ is the public site, The Worlds of C. R. Thompson.
